provenance.encodes: Statutory-citation shape (code name, section sign, section) of Bluebook R. 12.3; a heuristic for codes no rule names
provenance.how_to_verify: Not a citation rule: check each hit against Bluebook T1/T2 or the code's official citation form; a real code belongs in a statute or regulation rule.

positive.text: The tribe relies on Navajo Nation Code tit. 7, § 204 for the claim.
The statute, V.I. Code Ann. tit. 14, § 922, governs theft.
Both N. Mar. I. Code § 1101 and Am. Samoa Code Ann. § 3.0208 apply.
Territorial law, P.R. Laws Ann. tit. 33, § 4061, controls.

negative: Under § 1983 the plaintiff must show a deprivation.
Section 12 of the contract sets the fee.
The total cost was $ 500 and the deposit 10 percent.

note: Catch-all layer. A bare section sign (§ 1983) is a short form of an earlier statute and is never flagged; a leading signal word is skipped by reject.
